NOTE
**Still not ready — description not updated and no clear before/after screenshots**

New: The author added two screenshots in a comment and says the description is updated, but there is no new push. Missing: the description still reads "Screenshots to be added by author in comments", and the screenshots don't clearly show before and after at different screen sizes, which the issue asks for.

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and leave it with laurynmm, who gave the feedback; no reviewer yet.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the screenshots! The PR description still has the "Screenshots to be added" placeholder, so please move them in there. Please also show clear before/after at a few screen sizes, as described in [presenting visual changes](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/presenting-visual-changes.html).
```
